arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious Kerberos TGT Request from Non-DC Host
logsource:
  category: authentication
  product: windows
  service: security
  event_id: 4768
condition:
  - source_ip|cidr != '10.0.0.0/8'
  - destination_ip|cidr in ['10.0.8.0/24'] # Domain Controllers
  - status: 'failure'
  - event_count >= 10 within 600 seconds
level: high
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate authentication storms from applications
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1110/4/
description: Detects potential credential stuffing attacks targeting domain controllers from non-trusted subnets.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS_Profile {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS with common JA3 fingerprint patterns"
        author = "SOC Team"
        severity = "critical"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
    strings:
        $ja3_fingerprint = "e86f10bae9d6c7f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1" // Example JA3 hash
        $uri_patterns = /\/beacon\/\w{8}/ nocase
        $user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT" fullword ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
